 Violent Night 2 Featurette Shows David Harbour and Kristen Bell in Action
 By TMB 
 November 9, 2026 
5 min read 
In Movie News Chat 
 The holiday season is looking a lot more dangerous this year as David Harbour prepares to return to the big screen. Universal Pictures has released a new behind-the-scenes featurette for Violent Night 2 , offering fans a fresh look at the upcoming sequel. This time around, the action-packed Christmas adventure expands its roster by introducing Kristen Bell as Mrs. Claus, who appears ready to join the fight against a new group of holiday villains.
 https://x.com/ViolentNight/status/2117679503946436983?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw%7Ctwcamp%5Etweetembed%7Ctwterm%5E2117679503946436983%7Ctwgr%5E6b22cdc03a751bfbe9abec2ce669bbcef6f758ac%7Ctwcon%5Es1_&ref_url=https%3A%2F%2Fgeektyrant.com%2Fnews%2Fsanta-and-mrs-claus-kick-some-ass-in-funny-new-violent-night-2-featurette
 The sequel picks up with Santa Claus in a dire situation at the Silver Bell Mall in New Jersey. Cut off from the North Pole and stripped of his magical abilities, he must face off against a ruthless crime lord portrayed by Jared Harris. With the mall under siege and the local community in danger, Santa is forced to rely on his combat skills rather than holiday magic. The addition of Mrs. Claus to the narrative promises to raise the stakes, as the featurette suggests she is more than capable of handling herself when the situation turns violent.
 A Returning Creative Team
 Director Tommy Wirkola is back at the helm for this follow-up, reuniting with screenwriters Pat Casey and Josh Miller. The production team is once again collaborating with 87North, the company known for high-octane action films like John Wick and The Fall Guy. Given the studio’s track record for delivering creative and brutal fight sequences, fans can expect the sequel to maintain the high-energy, tongue-in-cheek tone that defined the 2022 original. You can view the official featurette here to see the cast in action.
 Expanding the Holiday Chaos
 The ensemble cast for this outing is quite extensive, featuring Joe Pantoliano, Daniela Melchior, and Andrew Bachelor. Additionally, the film includes a performance from AEW wrestler Maxwell Friedman, adding another layer to the eclectic group of characters caught in the mall takeover. The first film successfully blended festive cheer with gritty, unconventional action, and the inclusion of Bell as a partner in crime-fighting suggests the sequel aims to double down on that dynamic. For more details on the production, you can visit the official Universal Pictures website .
 The prospect of seeing Harbour and Bell play off one another while dismantling a criminal organization is a compelling hook for fans of the first film. By stripping Santa of his powers, the story forces the character to rely on his grit and determination, which should provide a grounded contrast to the absurdity of the premise. Violent Night 2 is scheduled to hit theaters on December 4, 2026.
